description: Legacy baseline entry for Monash enterprise Microsoft Copilot access via student credentials.
howToObtain: Log in with Monash student credentials at copilot.microsoft.com
costToUser: Provided under Monash institutional licensing for eligible students

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Make sure to log in using your Monash credentials before accessing Copilot.

description: Multimodal generative AI app powered by Google Gemini, offering Deep Research, Guided Learning, and Canvas features within the Monash Google Workspace environment for students aged 18+.
howToObtain: Opt-in via aioptin.monash.edu using Monash Google credentials
costToUser: Provided under Monash Google Workspace for Education licensing

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Monash staff and students (over the age of 18) can now opt in to gain access to the Google Gemini app.

Google Gemini is a multimodal AI, currently for students aged 18 and over (access to under 18 coming soon). It can be prompted with images, text, code, and video, and accessing it in a browser gives you tools like Deep Research, Guided Learning, Canvas, and more.

description: Enterprise generative AI assistant supporting drafting, coding, and image generation with commercial data protection (green shield).
howToObtain: Use Monash credentials to sign in at copilot.microsoft.com
costToUser: Provided under Monash institutional licensing for eligible students

evidence.evidenceSnippet: [Microsoft Copilot](https://www.monash.edu/ai/tools-training-and-resources/access-microsoft-copilot) is a generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) program that has capabilities to generate text and images in response to user prompts.
Monash University uses Copilot for work. To make sure your information is protected, it is recommended you log in using your Monash credentials.

description: Source-grounded research assistant operating on user-uploaded documents and notes, bundled with Google Gemini opt-in for students aged 18+.
howToObtain: Access notebooklm.google.com with active Monash Google account after opting in to Gemini

evidence.evidenceSnippet: You’ll also get access to Gemini Notebook, a standalone Google app.

Monash enterprise systems such as Copilot have enterprise data protections identified under the green shield in Monash Copilot. Google NotebookLM clearly identifies its privacy policy on its homepage. If you use paid AI services you likely have greater data protection and some free services have settings that allow you to prevent training on your data. As a general rule you should always avoid giving personal information to AI systems.
